subject: [RFC PATCH v3 07/14] mm/memcontrol: Charge/uncharge tiered memory to mem_cgroup

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch introduces tiered memory accounting to the Linux kernel's memory control group (memcg) system. It allows tracking of memory usage on a per-tier basis, where each tier represents a different type of memory. The patch adds functions to charge and uncharge memory for each tier, and updates existing code to use these new functions. This is a necessary step towards enforcing tiered limits on memory usage, which will be implemented in future patches. Currently, this only accounts for LRU folios (memory pages) and does not yet enforce tiered limits.
